description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView used to display log messages received via the LogNode interface. It formats log entries for display, converting log levels to readable strings, and supports chaining with other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data formatted for display and implements the LogNode interface to receive log messages.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors that initialize the LogView with various context and attribute parameters.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, including handling exceptions, converting log levels to strings, and appending the message to the UI.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings and delimiters conditionally based on null or empty status.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
